description: This is a PHP abstract class 'CsvDataImport' within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Import, which defines a contract for importing CSV data in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CsvDataImport
classes.description: An abstract class that declares the 'import' method for importing data, meant to be extended by concrete classes.
